questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and steer back onto the pavement gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Slow down gently using the brakes. Turn the steering wheel slowly to return to the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gently using the brakes. Turn the steering wheel slowly to return to the pavement.
questions.explanation: Keep driving with the wheels off the pavement. Slow down by gently pressing the brakes. Once you are at a safe speed, turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement. Do not sharply turn the steering wheel to force the vehicle back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop at a red light or slow down at a yellow light. Watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guardrail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead shows red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead shows green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: When the driver behind you wants to pass, you should:

options.text: Slow down to give the other driver room to pass safely and quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give the other driver room to pass safely and quickly.
questions.explanation: Slow down when a driver behind you wants to pass. This creates more space in front of your vehicle so they can complete the pass faster and more safely.

questions.question: What should you do when being tailgated?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is available.
If no right lane is available, wait until the road ahead is clear and slow down gradually to let them pass.

questions.explanation: If tailgated, move right if possible. If you cannot move right, slow down gradually once the road ahead is clear. This encourages the other driver to pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: What is the most effective way to reduce your risk of injury or death in a car crash?

options.text: Stay in the right lane on multilane highways.
Only drive between 3:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m.

questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt is the single most effective thing you can do to reduce your risk of death or injury in a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What are the colors of warning signs indicating upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs have black letters or symbols on a yellow background. Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: Another driver is trying to pass your car. You should:

options.text: Signal to the other driver when it is safe for them to pass.
Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to allow safe passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to allow safe passing.
questions.explanation: Stay in the right lane when someone passes you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and slow down if needed. This helps the other driver pass safely and return to the right lane.

questions.question: When approaching an accident scene, you should:

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop if you are involved or if emergency help has not yet arrived.

questions.explanation: Only stop if you are involved in the accident or if emergency help has not arrived. Keep your eyes on the road and keep driving. Do not stop just to look at an accident.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: On a two-lane street, your vehicle is being followed by a fire engine that is not using its emergency signals. You should:

options.text: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of its way.
Slow down, move as far to the right as possible, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle behind you has no siren or flashing lights on, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: As you drive, you're required to stop your vehicle:

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
Where there is a red light.
When a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at a stop sign, a red light, or when a police officer tells you to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two one-way roads separated by a median. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. You should:

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: Always stop for pedestrians in crosswalks. Slow down when you see pedestrians on or crossing the road. Be extra careful around children. Give pedestrians the right-of-way.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with no gates or flashing lights, but with a standard crossbuck sign. You should:

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn down your radio to listen for a train.
Only continue if a flagger signals you to do so.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you know no train is coming from either direction. Lower your radio to listen for trains. Follow all instructions from a flagger if one is present.

questions.question: To prevent hydroplaning, you should:

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread.
Make sure your tires are properly inflated.
Slow down when driving in the rain.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, check that your tire tread is good and your tires are inflated correctly. Slow down when it rains. Hydroplaning happens more often at higher speeds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway curves only to the right.
The highway makes a sharp right turn.
The highway curves right, then left.
The highway curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead is under construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is under construction.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. They warn drivers about work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert you to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: You may drive around or under a gate that is being lowered or raised at a railroad crossing:

options.text: If an approaching train is not too close.
If your vehicle will not damage the gate.
If you look carefully in both directions first.

questions.explanation: Flashing red lights, lowered crossing gates, and bells mean you must stop completely. Do not cross the tracks until the lights and bells stop and the gates are fully up. Never go around or under a moving gate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road is joining from the right.
